text: We will be traveling back to the capital soon.
zh: 我们很快就要返回王都了。

text: Are you ready, or would you still like to take a look around?
zh: 你准备好了吗？还是想再四处看看？

text: I want to go back to the capital.

Don't take too long.
Otherwise we'll go through the passage without you.
zh:
别耽搁太久。
不然我们就撇下你先过通道了。

text:
EVERYONE LISTEN!
We're now returning to the capital.
zh:
所有人听好！
我们现在返回王都。

text: Stay close to the guards and don't stray too far from the group.
zh: 紧跟卫兵，不要远离队伍。
